annotations.text:
PARCEL Fund — fractional real-estate token marketplace
Muted turquoise #6CC1C6, used sparingly: primary buttons, active tabs and presets, selected nav, progress fills, status dots. Everything else is a neutral grey ramp on near-black. Glass panels, soft shadows, no hard glow. Space Grotesk display, IBM Plex Mono on every number.

Explore opens on Trending now — properties ranked by purchase count, with a 24H / 7D / 30D switch that re-sorts the board, and a live purchase feed running under the top bar (hover pauses it).

Everything is clickable: the trending window, filter tabs, quick-buy presets, the token slider, tab switching, watchlists, claim rent.

All prices, yields, addresses and sponsor names are sample data for feeling out the flow — swap them before this goes anywhere real. The Reg D / 12-month lockup line on the buy panel is a placeholder too: your counsel decides the actual offering language.
